name: @functions-oneui/organism-smart-loading-container
description: Compound loading container organism for progressive async section layouts in OneUI.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/atoms run build && pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/theme run build && pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/react-utils run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/atoms run build && pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/theme run build && pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/react-utils run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/testing run build && pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/atoms run build && pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/theme run build && pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/react-utils run build && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:ui: pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/testing run build && pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/atoms run build && pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/theme run build && pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/react-utils run build && vitest --config vitest.config.ts --ui
